s1loc: Aylesbury has had a multi-million-pound Openreach fibre-to-the-premises build, with full fibre now reaching more than 28,000 homes and businesses across the town as part of the wider Buckinghamshire upgrade. The build keeps civils gangs, jointers and fibre engineers working through districts like Bedgrove, Watermead, Fairford Leys, Walton Court and the town centre, with ultrafast coverage now reaching a large share of premises.
